name: Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector (PIPDIC)
benefit:
- Financial assistance (Term Loan) up to a maximum of ₹10,00,00,000/- per project.
- Loan proceeds may be used for acquiring fixed assets, including the purchase of land, construction of buildings, and procurement of machinery, equipment, electricals, and miscellaneous fixed assets.
- The maximum repayment period is 8 years, which includes a maximum moratorium period of 2 years.

##### ***Benefit
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to the Small Scale or Medium Scale sector. 2. The applicant organization must be one of the following forms: - Proprietary Concern - Partnership Firm - Co-operative Society - Private Limited Company - Public Limited Company 3. The loan application purpose must be for one of the following purposes: - Setting-up New Small-Scale Units - Setting-up New Medium Scale Units - Expansion of Existing Units - Modernization of Existing Units - Diversification of Existing Units - Any other activities eligible for assistance under the scheme. 4. The total project cost ceiling must not exceed ₹20,00,00,000/-.
